seed_rule: SeedSequence([seed_root, case_index, replica, stream]).generate_state(1,uint64); measurement stream 0 and bootstrap stream 1 reused across both policies, equal pilot only

primary_test.rule: one-sided exact binomial lower-tail test with Bonferroni per molecule; all attempts counted; do not interpret non-rejection as calibration

secondary: Target attainment, joint target-met and covered, unconditional coverage, conditional coverage among valid/target-met, all-attempt shot cost, median width, point RMSE/bias conditional on finite estimates, fraction within 1.6 mHa, per-look rank, single-look and six-look Bonferroni intervals. Paired shot cost comparisons descriptive only; no matched-accuracy claim solely from target attainment.
failure_policy: All scheduled runs retain costs and count in denominators. Numerical acquisition failure is an uncovered unsuccessful attempt; one failed bootstrap draw invalidates its spread interval but not the delta interval or stop. Exhaustion reports its terminal interval but is not target attainment. Unexpected errors abort and preserve completed rows. No selective retries.
limitations: Two reused 8-qubit CAS(4e,4o) compact banks, ideal QWC sampling. Stop on estimated standard error, not chemical accuracy, interval half-width, or bootstrap spread. Fixed finite schedule; bootstrap conditions on final allocation and does not replay the acquisition process. No anytime-valid or finite-sample certificate, hardware claim or full-CISD transfer. 64 outer and 64 inner draws limit power and precision.
